product_name: OPPO K14x 5G Smartphone, Prism Violet, 4GB RAM, 64GB Storage, 6500mAh Battery, 45W Fast Charge
description: 5G CONNECTIVITY: The OPPO K14x 5G enables blazing-fast 5G network speeds for seamless browsing, streaming, and downloading. LONG-LASTING BATTERY: Equipped with a massive 6500mAh battery, the K14x keeps you powered through the day and beyond without interruption. 45W FAST CHARGING: Rapidly recharge your device with 45W fast charge technology, minimising downtime and getting you back to full power quickly. PERFORMANCE AND STORAGE: Comes with 4GB RAM and 64GB internal storage, providing smooth multitasking and ample space for your apps, photos, and files. ELEGANT DESIGN: Features a stunning Prism Violet finish with a geometric pattern on the back, giving the phone a premium and eye-catching appearance.
